results.notes: Other category page of 'Electric bikes', latest collection 21 Oct 2026: Prompts Analysis shows 1 row 'Which electric bike brands are best for commuting in London?' (Other on both category and type), badge 'Other', theme chips 'folding design', 'value for money' '+8'. The panel is open on that row at page load; a click on the selected row closes it, a second click reopens it (same as first run). Panel: header = prompt text + badges 'Other' and 'United Kingdom'; engine segmented control 'ChatGPT' / 'Gemini'; badge text 'Sentiment - CHATGPT' (textContent, CSS uppercase) Positive; THEMES folding design, stylish design, robustness, performance and range, versatile and durable; RESPONSE text with 'Show more'; Sources (moveelectric.com, fullycharged.com, road.cc, menshealth.com) + 'All sources 5'. Switch to Gemini: 'SENTIMENT - GEMINI' Positive; themes folding design, value for money, servicing options, power for hills, belt drive, free insurance; another response; sources cyclingnews.com, british360.co.uk, bikeradar.com, cyclingelectric.com - all four blocks updated. The 'Other Details' design frame name is not a visible label (layout = category detail panel). Side observation (known family): sources 'menshealth.com' (ChatGPT) and 'bikeradar.com' (Gemini) shown with the domain as title. Same as first run (PASS).
